purpose: Monitor dashboard sign-in, extension connection, local job tracking, and dashboard sync flow.

privacy.logPolicy: Do not log account tokens, authorization headers, passwords, or secrets.

expectedFlows.name: Dashboard connects extension
expectedFlows.notes: connect-sync-started and connect-sync-completed only appear when local tracked jobs exist.

expectedFlows.name: Widget receives connected session
expectedFlows.notes: This proves the active job-board widget heard the dashboard connection broadcast.

expectedFlows.name: Track job locally first
expectedFlows.notes: Basic job tracking is not Pro gated. Sync depends only on a valid dashboard session.

expectedFlows.name: Profile sync from side panel
expectedFlows.notes: Used when the side panel syncs profile settings to the dashboard.

dashboardTimeline.failure: Extension ID is missing, stale, disabled, or Chrome messaging is blocked.

dashboardTimeline.success: Dashboard session and account profile were read.
dashboardTimeline.failure: User is not signed in, account row is missing, or Supabase returned an error.

dashboardTimeline.success: Extension stored the dashboard session and returned AUTOTIME_CONNECT_ACCOUNT ok.
dashboardTimeline.failure: Extension background script rejected the message, storage failed, or sync failed.

dashboardTimeline.success: Dashboard wrote an extension connection audit row.
dashboardTimeline.failure: Connection can still work; audit failure is non-blocking but should be investigated.

external-message-untrusted.meaning: A non-dashboard origin tried to message the extension.
external-message-untrusted.operatorAction: Check allowed dashboard origins and extension externally_connectable configuration.

connect-invalid-message.meaning: Dashboard sent a malformed connect payload.
connect-invalid-message.operatorAction: Inspect the dashboard connection timeline and deployed web bundle version.

account-session-save-failed.meaning: The extension could not persist the dashboard session.
account-session-save-failed.operatorAction: Export the diagnostic log, reload the extension, and check Chrome storage availability.

connect-sync-failed.meaning: Extension stored the session but could not sync local tracked jobs.
connect-sync-failed.operatorAction: Inspect response details, check dashboard API auth, and retry from the widget or side panel.

account-connected-broadcast-failed.meaning: The extension connected but could not notify active tabs.
account-connected-broadcast-failed.operatorAction: Refresh the job-board tab; dashboard sync should still work from stored session.

track-job-missing-url.meaning: Detected job data did not include a usable URL.
track-job-missing-url.operatorAction: Check extractor output for the specific job board and add board-specific parsing if needed.

profile-sync-failed.meaning: Side panel profile sync to dashboard failed.
profile-sync-failed.operatorAction: Check session state, dashboard API response, and exported diagnostic log.

operatingRules: Track Job always saves locally first.
Free and Pro users both sync basic tracked jobs when a dashboard session exists.
Only advanced features are Pro gated.
Every failed connection path should leave a diagnostic event with a human-readable reason.
